note: No spec can override these. An exception needs approvals[gate=exception] in Krish's words.

invariants.rule: Every cut carries burned-in house captions
invariants.enforced_by: schema brand.captions literal 'house'; BrandFrame always draws CaptionTrack

invariants.rule: Mark tile on every beat; channel pill on the section beat; grain behind
invariants.enforced_by: FormatMaster wraps every beat in BrandFrame; qc_brand template match

invariants.rule: Specs and devices name colour roles, never hex
invariants.enforced_by: lint brand.no_hex; ESLint no-raw-hex in apps/renderer/src/engine

invariants.rule: Picture is never retimed apart from its audio; one EDL drives picture, dialogue, bed, SFX and captions in one render
invariants.enforced_by: FormatMaster + clock.ts; no mux path in ve

invariants.rule: No per-piece compositions or render scripts
Evidence is never generated; generated pictures carry a visible label
mind.the.gap ends in a dated call
Every number on screen names whoever produced it
No synthetic Krish (HeyGen avatar, voice clone) until Krish approves a realism test
invariants.ruling: Krish 2026-10-27: on backup until trained and convincing

invariants.rule: ve has no publish verb; agents never publish, send or schedule
Readiness is computed from qc.json bound to the mp4 sha, the Critic verdict and Krish's approvals; no agent writes a pass
